testcase.name: Scenario: Collapse descendants of the Origin folder: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/application/model-browser/model-browser.feature:421:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Collapse descendants of the Origin folder ✔ Given an active part with a visible block is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And the Origin folder is expanded with its planes, axes and center point visible as rows ✔ When the user right-clicks the Origin folder ✔ Then its context menu offers Expand All Children and collapses All Children ✔ When the user chooses Collapse All Children ✔ Then the Origin folder remains expanded with its direct reference rows visible ✔ And the block remains visible in the same apparent view ✔ When the user clicks the Origin expansion control ✔ Then the reference rows are hidden and the Origin folder remains visible ✔ When the user clicks the Origin expansion control again ✔ Then the reference rows are visible again
